## Reference

`POST /api/v1/models/definitions`

Returns parameter schemas and defaults for the requested model names.

### Request body

Content type: `application/json` (required)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `names` | array of string | yes | Array of model slugs to fetch definitions for (e.g. ['dragon-cup', 'phone-nest']) |

### Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `200` | Model definitions |
| `400` | Validation error |

### Example request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.bitbybit.dev/api/v1/models/definitions" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ ... }'
```

Authentication: send your key in the `x-api-key` header. The full machine-readable specification is at [openapi.json](https://learn.bitbybit.dev/openapi.json).
